_comment: TEMPLATE. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> before `ask deploy`. HomeHub is a multi-capability skill: Smart Home (Lambda forwarder) + custom voice intents (HTTPS endpoint). Verify field names against the current ASK skill-manifest schema at deploy time.

en-IN.name: HomeHub
en-IN.description: Control the devices you share from HomeHub, and ask about your shopping list, chores, dinner and today's briefing. HomeHub never stores voice recordings.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Home Hub what's on the shopping list
Alexa, ask Home Hub for my briefing
Alexa, turn on the living room lamp
